$comment: Machine form of CONTROLS.md. Each control names the rules that verify it, so the claim is checked at every commit rather than asserted once a year.

controls.name: No credentials in source or history
controls.statement: Credentials are supplied by the environment or a secret manager and never committed. Synthetic values in the test corpus are waived inline, by name, with the reason recorded at the point of use.

implementation.mechanism: airtight secrets pack plus inline waivers

controls.name: No unparameterized injection sinks
controls.statement: Queries are parameterized, subprocesses take argument arrays, and no code path compiles a string at runtime.

implementation.mechanism: airtight js and py sink packs

controls.name: Dependencies resolve deterministically over TLS
controls.statement: Every dependency is version-pinned, fetched over HTTPS, and free of install lifecycle scripts we did not write.

implementation.mechanism: airtight dep pack plus a committed lockfile

controls.name: CI workflows are hardened
controls.statement: Third-party actions are pinned to commit SHAs, the token is least-privilege, and untrusted pull request code is never executed with repository secrets.

controls.name: Containers run as a non-root user
controls.statement: Shipping images drop to a non-root user before CMD and pin their base image.
evidence: This project ships no container image.

controls.name: The engine cannot print a credential
controls.statement: Redaction happens at Finding construction and is enforced again by a scan-wide vault on every output path. A build-gating test plants known secrets and greps every output mode for them.
evidence: tests/redaction.test.mjs drives every output path including the CLI
